meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过二维码或配对码直连 WhatsApp 频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中直接连接 WhatsApp 发送或接收消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel via QR code or pairing code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to directly connect WhatsApp in your app to send or receive messages.

howto.what: 为 NanoClaw 添加 WhatsApp 频道：注册 Baileys 适配器，安装固定版本依赖，构建测试后，用 QR 码或配对码认证。按专用/共享号码设置相关配置，使智能体可收发 WhatsApp 消息。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加或连接 WhatsApp 频道时触发。先进行号码安全检查，选择专用或共享并确认风险，再继续安装与认证。

say.note: 开始流程，会先问号码类型

say.text: 用我现有的手机号连接WhatsApp
say.note: 按共享号码处理，先显示封号风险警告

say.text: 我想用配对码方式连接
say.note: 选择配对码认证，需输入手机号

howto.what_en: Adds WhatsApp to NanoClaw: registers the Baileys adapter, installs pinned deps, builds, tests, then links via QR or pairing code. Sets config per dedicated/shared number so the agent can send/receive WhatsApp messages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add or connect a WhatsApp channel. A required number safety check runs first: pick dedicated or shared, confirm risk, then install/auth proceeds.

say_en.text: Add a WhatsApp channel for me
say_en.note: Starts the flow, asks number type first

say_en.text: Connect WhatsApp with my existing number
say_en.note: Treated as shared, shows account-risk warning first

say_en.text: I want to link with a pairing code
say_en.note: Chooses pairing-code auth, prompts for phone
